title: Astrid and the Tide
author: Wren Nystrom
blurb: Vesper Vasquez, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
